providers.title: Van der Waerden's theorem with a recursive bound
providers.scope: W_r(k) <= F(r,k) for an explicit recursion; W_r(1) = 1, W_r(2) = r + 1, W_1(k) = k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Digit product
providers.scope: A two-colouring of Z/NZ without monochromatic k-term progressions gives W_r(k) > N^floor(log2 r).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Many colours
providers.scope: W_r(k) > exp((log r)^2 / (64 log 2)) for r >= 256 and k >= 3.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Sign vectors of affine functions
providers.scope: s affine functions on R^e realize at most (e+1)^2 (s+1)^e sign vectors in {-,0,+}^s.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Tails of fair coin flips
providers.scope: For l fair bits, P(|X - l/2| >= l/4) <= 2 exp(-l/8).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local lemma (Erdos-Lovasz)
providers.scope: If P(E) <= z_E prod over neighbours (1 - z_F), all events are avoided with positive probability.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A prime between k and 2k^2
providers.scope: For large k there is a prime in (k, 2k^2].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Neighbourhoods of the adaptive mesh
providers.scope: Near an interval of width w, mesh intervals have width at least w/16 and there are at most 49 endpoints.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Global label words
providers.scope: The number of label words along progressions is exp(O(k^(3/10) log k)).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local patterns through a label (OpenAI)
providers.scope: At most (CDh)^(6D) eligible patterns of period h pass through a given label, independently of interval widths.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Balanced outer colouring (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A colouring of labels balancing light positions of progressions and regular positions of eligible patterns.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Balanced-or-affine dichotomy (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Every progression sees each outer colour at least k/100 times or has affine centred second coordinates.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Four occurrences of a key
providers.scope: A box together with an integer squared-norm band occurs at most four times along a progression.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cyclic two-colouring (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Z/NZ with N >= k^(ck) has a two-colouring without monochromatic k-term progressions, for all large k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Superexponential van der Waerden numbers (OpenAI)
providers.scope: W_r(k) > k^(ck floor(log2 r)) with c = 10^-5 for all large k and every r >= 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
